problem: The score track is `flex-1 min-w-0` inside a `w-fit` card, so it has no width to grow into; the supplied measurements show the track at 0.0 px at 320 and 390 px.
impact: The score bar never renders on any supported width.
quote: <div className="h-2 min-w-0 flex-1 rounded-full bg-line" data-measure="score-track">

problem: The meter track takes its width from the label above it, so the same 80% renders a 49.9 px, 84.8 px and 57.0 px fill in en, de and ar (see the measurements).
impact: The same value looks different in each locale and comparisons across languages are wrong.

problem: A band 112% wide sits inside an `overflow-hidden` container; at 390 px the total's right edge is at 401 px while the container ends at 374 px, so the total is clipped (measured visible width 43.6 of 70.6 px).
impact: The order total is cut off on phones.
quote: <div className="flex w-[112%] items-center justify-between gap-6 bg-paper px-4 py-3">

problem: The table sits in a fixed `w-[720px]` wrapper with no scroll container; at 390 px the document scrolls sideways (scrollWidth 752 against clientWidth 390).
impact: Phone users must pan the whole page sideways to read the orders.

problem: The badge is `w-48` with `pe-6` and centred text, so the score sits 12 px off the centre of the box (measured -12 px in en, +12 px in ar).
impact: The number looks misplaced inside its box.
quote: <div className="w-48 rounded-panel border border-line bg-surface pe-6 py-3 text-center" data-measure="badge-box">

problem: The fade overlay uses `left-0` with `bg-gradient-to-r` and the heading uses `ml-4`, in a component that otherwise uses `ps-4` and `pe-12`; in `ar` the fade stays on the left edge while the strip starts on the right (measurements show overlayLeft 16 px in both locales).
impact: The Arabic layout does not mirror: the fade covers the wrong end of the strip and the heading is misaligned.
